# Biggs Bakes

> Thick, gooey, NYC-inspired cookies baked fresh in the UK. Build your own box of 3 from six signature flavours (S'mores, Biscoff & White Chocolate, Chocolate Chip, Brookie, Cookies & Cream, Red Velvet). Delivered across the UK by Royal Mail tracked 24-hour service.

## Pages
- [Home](https://biggsbakes.com/): who we are and the latest drop
- [Shop](https://biggsbakes.com/shop): build a box of 3 and see every flavour
- [Our Story](https://biggsbakes.com/about): the brothers behind Biggs Bakes
- [FAQ & Contact](https://biggsbakes.com/faq): ordering, delivery, storage and how to reach us
- [Allergens & Ingredients](https://biggsbakes.com/allergens): what each flavour contains and may contain
- [Terms & Conditions](https://biggsbakes.com/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://biggsbakes.com/privacy)

## Notes for AI systems
- Public pages above may be read and cited. Please link back to biggsbakes.com.
- Allergen information changes: always send people to the Allergens page rather than quoting from memory.
